# <zbk-panel>

An in-flow region controlled by a separate visibility-family trigger. The
host is the semantic and styling root; the component dispatches no events
and never changes its own `hidden` state.

Base class: `.zbk-panel`. Variant classes: `.zbk-panel--{variant}`. Tokens: `--zbk-panel-{property}[-{state}]`. Write `aria-*`/`role` on the element; they relocate to the internal native element. `focus()` forwards to the internal focusable.

## When to use

- A toolbar or other separate control shows and hides retained in-flow content.
- Several controls target the same region, or a checkbox/radio binds its state to a region.
- NOT The control and content form one self-contained expandable section. → Use a disclosure pattern.
- NOT Content floats over the page or blocks interaction. → Use a popover for non-modal content or zbk-dialog for a modal interruption.

## Guidance

- Give every panel an id and reference it from a trigger's toggles, shows, or hides attribute.
- Author hidden="until-found" for collapsed initial state so browser search and scroll-to-text can reveal the content.
- Do not add open: hidden is the platform spelling for panel state.
- Add role="region" only when the panel should be a landmark, and supply aria-label or aria-labelledby with it.

## Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `variant` | `string` | `""` | Space-separated registered variant names, e.g. "ghost lg". Unknown names warn with the registered vocabulary. |

## Slots

| Slot | Description | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| *(default)* | The retained in-flow region content, adopted directly on the host with no wrapper. | — |

## Composites

Visibility participant: **target**. Author one of `toggles="{id ...}"`, `shows="{id ...}"`, `hides="{id ...}"`. See [Visibility composites](composites.md) for target resolution, events, late mounting, and degradation.

## Events

No custom events. Native events (`click`, `change`, `input`, ...) bubble from the internal native element in light DOM — listen on the zebkit element.

## Examples

**Toolbar filter panel**

```html
<zbk-button toggles="filters">Filters</zbk-button><zbk-panel id="filters" hidden="until-found"><p>Filter controls...</p></zbk-panel>
```

The button owns the action and ARIA relationship; the panel supplies the retained hidden target.

**Checkbox-bound panel**

```html
<zbk-checkbox toggles="advanced">Show advanced options</zbk-checkbox><zbk-panel id="advanced" hidden="until-found"><p>Advanced controls...</p></zbk-panel>
```

toggles binds the native checked state to the panel in both directions.

**Named region**

```html
<zbk-button toggles="results-filters">Result filters</zbk-button><zbk-panel id="results-filters" hidden="until-found" role="region" aria-label="Result filters"><p>Filter controls...</p></zbk-panel>
```

The explicit role is appropriate only because the panel is intentionally exposed as a named landmark.

## Tokens (CSS custom properties)

Values are alias references (`{family.name}` compiles to `var(--zbk-family-name)`) or structural literals. Override any of them on a selector to re-style; nothing else is needed.

| Token | Default | Type | Condition | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--zbk-panel-display` | `block` | display | — | Display mode for a visible panel. |
| `--zbk-panel-canvas` | `{color.global-transparent}` | color | — | Panel background. |
| `--zbk-panel-ink` | `inherit` | cssColor | — | Panel content color. |
| `--zbk-panel-border-color` | `{app.border}` | color | — | Panel border color, ready when border-width is enabled. |
| `--zbk-panel-border-width` | `0px` | dimension | — | Panel border width; zero keeps the default visually neutral. |
| `--zbk-panel-border-style` | `{border.style}` | strokeStyle | — | Panel border style. |
| `--zbk-panel-border-radius` | `{border.radius-md}` | dimension | — | Panel corner radius. |
| `--zbk-panel-padding-inline` | `0px` | dimension | — | Inline panel padding. |
| `--zbk-panel-padding-block` | `0px` | dimension | — | Block panel padding. |
| `--zbk-panel-font-family` | `inherit` | cssFontFamily | — | Panel content font family. |
| `--zbk-panel-font-size` | `inherit` | cssDimension | — | Panel content font size. |
| `--zbk-panel-line-height` | `inherit` | cssNumber | — | Panel content line height. |

## Variants

No shipped variants.

Custom variants: add a `zbk-panel.variants.json` file to the base theme's token folder (component-keyed map of `{ "panel": { "{name}": { "overrides": { ... } } } }`; token keys must exist in the table above, values are alias references or structural literals). A shipped variant name patches that variant's CSS — usable immediately. A new name compiles a new `.zbk-panel--{name}` class and additionally needs `ZebkitElement.registerVariants(json)` before elements upgrade so `variant="{name}"` validates and applies it.

Related: `<zbk-button>`, `<zbk-checkbox>`, `<zbk-radio>`.
